description: This header file declares the interface for the device service component in a Zigbee SDK, including functions for device discovery, management, resource access, system properties, and event notifications.

methods.name: deviceServiceRestoreConfig
methods.description: Restores configuration data from a specified directory, used for RMA restore.

methods.name: deviceServiceDiscoverStart
methods.description: Starts device discovery for specified device classes with a timeout and optional orphaned device limit.

methods.name: deviceServiceDiscoverStop
methods.description: Stops ongoing device discovery for specified classes or all if null.

methods.name: deviceServiceIsDiscoveryActive
methods.description: Checks if any device discovery process is currently active.

methods.name: deviceServiceIsInRecoveryMode
methods.description: Checks if the system is in recovery mode.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetAllDevices
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all devices in the system.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetDevicesByMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves devices matching a metadata ID and optional value.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a device by its UUID.

methods.name: deviceServiceIsDeviceKnown
methods.description: Checks if a device UUID is known to the system.

methods.name: deviceServiceIsDeviceBlacklisted
methods.description: Checks if a device UUID is blacklisted.

methods.name: deviceServiceRemoveDevice
methods.description: Removes a device by UUID.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetDeviceByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a device by its URI.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetDevicesByProfile
methods.description: Retrieves devices supporting a specific profile.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetDevicesByDeviceClass
methods.description: Retrieves devices of a specific device class.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetDevicesByDeviceDriver
methods.description: Retrieves devices using a specific driver.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetDevicesBySubsystem
methods.description: Retrieves devices belonging to a subsystem.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetEndpointsByProfile
methods.description: Retrieves endpoints supporting a specific profile.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetResourceByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a resource by URI.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetEndpointByUri
methods.description: Retrieves an endpoint by URI.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetEndpointById
methods.description: Retrieves an endpoint by device UUID and endpoint ID.

methods.name: deviceServiceRemoveEndpointById
methods.description: Removes an endpoint by device UUID and endpoint ID.

methods.name: deviceServiceWriteResource
methods.description: Writes a value to a resource.

methods.name: deviceServiceExecuteResource
methods.description: Executes a resource with optional arguments and response.

methods.name: deviceServiceChangeResourceMode
methods.description: Changes the mode of a resource.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetSystemProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a system property value.

methods.name: deviceServiceSetSystemProperty
methods.description: Sets a system property value.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata value for a URI.

methods.name: deviceServiceSetMetadata
methods.description: Sets metadata value for a URI.

methods.name: deviceServiceReloadDatabase
methods.description: Reloads the device database from storage.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetDeviceDescriptorForDevice
methods.description: Gets a device descriptor for a device.

methods.name: deviceServiceDumpZigbeeConfig
methods.description: Returns a dump of Zigbee configuration.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetMetadataByUriPattern
methods.description: Queries metadata matching a URI pattern.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetResourcesByUriPattern
methods.description: Queries resources matching a URI pattern.

methods.name: deviceServiceIsReadyForDevices
methods.description: Checks if system is ready to work with devices.

methods.name: deviceServiceNotifySystemPowerEvent
methods.description: Notifies system power state changes.

methods.name: deviceServiceNotifyPropertyChange
methods.description: Notifies property change events.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current device service status.

methods.name: deviceServiceDestroyServiceStatus
methods.description: Frees resources of a DeviceServiceStatus object.

methods.name: deviceServiceIsDeviceInCommFail
methods.description: Checks if a device is in communication failure.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetDeviceFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version of a device.
